name: Dify
tagline: Open-source LLM app development platform for building visual RAG pipelines, workflows, and local AI agents.
real_test_summary: Tested building a local document Q&A workflow wired to a local Ollama model and knowledge base. Visual node orchestration makes testing retrieval chunks and prompt steps straightforward.
pros: Visual workflow builder for RAG pipelines, tools, and agents
Connects easily to local Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends
Apache-2.0 open-source license with self-hosting support
cons: Self-hosted stack uses multiple containers and background workers
More complex than lightweight single-file chat clients
